title: Ukubekezela okwahlala isikhathi eside kunezinsizi
intro: Umdala onesineke esaba yindaba edumile, umbono wakhe waphela ngenxa yosizi, kodwa ukholo lwakhe ohlelweni lwaphezulu aluzange luntengantenge. Lo muntu wabuka amadodana ayishumi nambili ekhula aba izisekelo zezizwe, ezwa ukulahlekelwa okubuhlungu kwengane ethandekayo kakhulu, futhi waba uphawu olungapheli lokubekezela okuhle naphezu kosizi olukhulu. Umphefumulo ohlonishwayo onendaba elandiswa kuwo wonke amakhasi esambulo. Ungakwazi yini ukubona lo muntu ovela ku-Quran?
clues: Ngangingumprofethi ondaba yakhe ilandiswa ngokuningiliziwe ngaphakathi kwe-surah enkulu ye-Quran.
Nganginamadodana ayishumi nambili aba oyise bezizwe zakwa-Israyeli.
Ngatshela amadodana ami ukuthi angene ngamasango ahlukene, funa abonakale njengesizwe esisodwa.
Amehlo ami acwebezela ngenxa yokukhala okungapheli ngenxa yomntwana engimthandayo othathwe kimi.
Ngenqaba ukuphelelwa yithemba ngisho nalapho amanye amadodana ami engincenga ukuba ngikwenze lokho, ethi ngikhononda ku-Allah kuphela.
Nginguyise womprofethi uYusuf, ogama lakhe lisho ukuthi 'umkhulisi' ngesi-Arabhu.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
